actions.description: Inspect builder-app service unit and slot directory
actions.command: systemctl cat builder-app.service; ls -la /opt/builder/ 2>&1; systemctl status builder-app.service 2>&1 | head -5

actions.description: Check python availability and data dir
actions.output_excerpt:
/run/current-system/sw/bin/python3
Python 3.14.6
ls: cannot access '/var/lib/builder': No such file or directory

Exit code: exit status: 2

actions.command: systemctl reset-failed builder-app.service && systemctl start builder-app.service && sleep 1 && systemctl is-active builder-app.service

actions.description: Verify health, PUT, GET, and 404 behavior
actions.command: curl -s -w '%{http_code} ' http://localhost:8080/health; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X PUT --data-binary 'hello durable world' http://localhost:8080/records/rec1; curl -s -w '%{http_code} ' http://localhost:8080/records/rec1; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/records/missing

actions.description: Restart service and confirm record survives
actions.command: systemctl restart builder-app.service && sleep 1 && curl -s http://localhost:8080/records/rec1 && echo && systemctl is-enabled builder-app.service && systemctl is-active builder-app.service
